summary: Add a separate public-service publish workflow for verified draft assets
details: Dispatch the publisher from master with an existing public release tag, including older drafts that do not contain the new workflow.
Verify the annotated tag, successful tag build, complete release assets, checksums, clean source identity and release-bound installer before promotion.
Revalidate the approved asset fingerprint through the existing usdb-release environment, publish as a pre-release without taking Latest, and verify all anonymous downloads.
Preserve original assets and notes on publication and retries; clarify that draft installation URLs return HTTP 404 until the Publish workflow runs.
operator_actions: After the public tag build succeeds, run USDB Public Services Publish from master with the existing release_id; allow master if the usdb-release environment restricts deployment refs.
